placeholder: Write in {mine}… (or write {target} to check it)
hint_keys: Enter: send 1  ·  Click: paste  ·  Esc: close
nothing_copied: Copy some text first (select it and press Ctrl+C).
need_key: Add your Claude API key to start translating.
copied_only: Copied. Press Ctrl+V where you want it.
err_paste: Couldn't paste into the other window. The text is copied: press Ctrl+V there.
err_key_invalid: Your Claude API key isn't valid. Check it in Settings.
err_key_denied: Your API key can't use this model: {detail}
err_no_credit: Your Claude API credit is empty. Add credit at platform.claude.com.
err_rate_limited: Too many requests at once. Wait a moment and try again.
err_no_connection: No connection to Claude. Check your internet.
err_timeout: Claude took too long to answer. Try again.
err_server: Claude is busy right now ({detail}). Try again in a moment.
err_refused: Claude declined to translate this text.
err_bad_answer: Claude's answer was incomplete. Try again.
tray_running: Terjiman is running. Press {key} in any program to open it.
key_placeholder_saved: A key is saved. Paste a new one to replace it.
key_where: Saved in Windows Credential Manager, not in a file.
quality_best: Best: Claude Opus 5.5 (about 1–2 US cents per message)
quality_fast: Fast and cheap: Claude Haiku 5.5 (weaker in Uyghur)
shortcut_taken: This shortcut is already used by another program. Choose another one in Settings.
shortcut_invalid: Use Ctrl, Alt or Shift together with one key.
copy_twice: Ctrl+C twice: show the copied text in my language
upd_not_repo: Updates come from GitHub, but this copy isn't connected to the GitHub repository.
upd_no_git: Git isn't installed, so updates can't be downloaded.
upd_notify: A Terjiman update is ready. Click here to install it.
